_note: Approximate areas of control, drawn generously and clipped to the coastline at load time (clip: land). Coordinates are [lng, lat]. Ancient borders were fuzzy; treat these as a guide.

properties.label: Southern Italy: many cities go over to Hannibal after Cannae
Bruttium: Hannibal's last stronghold in Italy
Cisalpine Gaul: the Gauls rise and join Hannibal
Kingdom of Syracuse: Rome's ally from 263 BC, sides with Carthage 214 BC
Sardinia and Corsica: seized by Rome
Barcid Spain: the empire built by Hamilcar, Hasdrubal and Hannibal
North of the Ebro: Roman foothold
